title: VIXEN build witness must survive elastic queue resize and IO-pressure head stalls
body: The documented queued full product build (bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-edmat12 --resource build --label cx-edmat12:wave-product-build -- bash -lc 'cmake --build build/wsl-debug') was admitted but the live wrapper elastic resize called box-queue-core with unexpected argument true and exited 2; a fresh retry then stalled at head_blocked_io-pressure_114s_budget_spent and was terminated. The narrower queued target cmake --build build/wsl-debug --target vixen_editor succeeded once the queue recovered. The queue/build pipeline should fail early with a located diagnostic or make elastic resize and IO-pressure backoff transparent/reliable for admitted product builds. Tier luna: cross-tool queue/runtime behavior needs diagnosis; effort M.
